summary: SHIP-007 (decode tps ≥ 30 tok/s on RTX 4090 with --features cuda) is multi-PR scope: CUDA path has structural parity bug (cosine -0.005 vs CPU); workaround paths give 5.6-9.3 tok/s, all below 10 tok/s spec H12 floor and well below 30 tok/s SHIP-007 floor.

primary_blocker.name: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS in cuBLASLt FP8 JIT warmup
primary_blocker.error: [PMAT-053] FP8 cache warmup failed (non-fatal): CUDA stream synchronization failed: CUDA driver error: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS (code: 700)
primary_blocker.workaround: APR_SKIP_FP8_WARMUP=1 env var (added in commit e4390cb4b on 2026-04-25)
primary_blocker.workaround_effect: bypasses FP8 warmup, but reveals deeper parity bug

secondary_blocker.name: CUDA vs CPU parity gate failure
secondary_blocker.error: PARITY-GATE FAILED: GPU computes a DIFFERENT function than CPU. Cosine similarity: -0.005190 (required: ≥0.98) CPU argmax: 334 | GPU argmax: 8127 Max absolute logit difference: 19.5053
secondary_blocker.diagnostic: This model's dimensions (hidden=3584, heads=28, kv_heads=4) cause GPU forward pass to diverge from CPU
secondary_blocker.interpretation: CUDA path is structurally broken for Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct dimensions. Not a single-fix bug.

with_parity_gate_skipped.verdict: 5.6 tok/s is BELOW spec H12 floor (10) AND BELOW SHIP-007 floor (30); even with broken-but-running CUDA path, can't meet SHIP-007

findings: PMAT-053 (FP8 cache warmup) and GH-181 (workspace reinit) located in crates/aprender-serve/src/cuda/executor/{layers/cublas_prefill/attention.rs:1319-1487, workspace.rs:252-262}
Likely root cause: out-of-bounds GPU memory access during FP8 warmup (m=16, n=hidden_dim=3584, k=hidden_dim=3584); buffer size mismatch or dangling pointer from incompletely-initialized cache
Alternative root cause: allocation order — FP8 cache allocates after KV cache; memory fragmentation could cause 256-element padding to fail at workspace.rs:51 (GH-215 fix)
Recent suspicious commit: e4390cb4b (2026-04-25) — acknowledged the warmup is poisoning the context but only added APR_SKIP_FP8_WARMUP=1 workaround (opt-in, not default fix)
Recent suspicious commit: 8bd4ce5ad (2026-05-07) — rewrote workspace.rs from scratch with GH-215 padding logic; FP8 warmup bug remains

option_a_conservative.description: Default APR_SKIP_FP8_WARMUP=1 in apr bench code path only (not apr run). Add FALSIFY-CUDA-WARMUP-001 to pin the regression.
option_a_conservative.status_today: BLOCKED by secondary parity blocker — even with FP8 warmup skipped, CUDA path is structurally broken (cosine -0.005)

option_b_root_fix.description: Pre-checks before cuBLASLt FP8 GEMM call: verify fp8_weight_ptr bounds, validate workspace pre-init, pad warmup scratch to 256-element GEMV boundary. Add FALSIFY-CUDA-ALLOCATION-LIFECYCLE-001.
option_b_root_fix.status_today: INSUFFICIENT — fixes FP8 warmup but does not address the parity gate failure

option_c_forensic.description: Add compute-sanitizer integration; identify exact line that triggers out-of-bounds access.
option_c_forensic.status_today: DIAGNOSTIC TOOL — does not directly fix; necessary for full root-fix
